cards.front: Recall a key point about Circuit Construction & PCB Design
cards.back: A breadboard provides a solderless prototyping platform with internal spring contacts connecting rows and columns.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Circuit Construction & PCB Design
cards.back: Breadboard connections are temporary and suitable for testing circuit designs before permanent construction.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Circuit Construction & PCB Design
cards.back: Stripboard (Veroboard) has copper tracks in rows; tracks must be cut to isolate sections where connections are not wanted.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Circuit Construction & PCB Design
cards.back: PCB design involves creating a layout with copper tracks that connect component pads according to the circuit schematic.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Circuit Construction & PCB Design
cards.back: PCB design rules include: adequate track width for current, sufficient clearance between tracks, and correct pad sizes.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Circuit Construction & PCB Design
cards.back: Soldering creates a permanent electrical and mechanical joint; a good solder joint is shiny, concave and covers both pad and lead.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Circuit Construction & PCB Design
cards.back: The soldering process: clean the tip, heat both pad and lead simultaneously, apply solder, remove solder then remove iron.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Circuit Construction & PCB Design
cards.back: Dry joints occur when the joint is not heated sufficiently; they appear dull and granular and have high resistance.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Circuit Construction & PCB Design
cards.back: Component placement should follow the signal flow from input to output, with decoupling capacitors close to ICs.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Circuit Construction & PCB Design
cards.back: Through-hole components have leads that pass through the board; surface-mount devices (SMDs) are soldered on the same side.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Circuit Construction & PCB Design
cards.back: A solder mask (green coating) on a PCB prevents solder bridges between adjacent tracks during soldering.

cards.front: Recall a key point about Circuit Construction & PCB Design
cards.back: Design for manufacture (DFM) considerations include: minimising board layers, standardising component orientation and providing test points.

cards.front: What should you know about gcse electronics exam tips — circuit construction & pcb design?
cards.back: 1. For Circuit Construction & PCB Design questions, use correct electronic symbols and terminology 2. Always show your working in calculations, including units at each step 3. When analysing circuits, state which law or rule you are applying first 4. For evaluation questions on Circuit Construction & PCB Design, compare component choices and consider cost, reliability and tolerance 5. Draw circuit diagrams neatly with conventional symbols
Describe the process of constructing a circuit from prototype to PCB, including the role of breadboarding, stripboard construction, PCB design rules and soldering technique.
